comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus prune a dead rose stem above a retained bud and dispose of the cutting.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses hex-key and collar manipulation; record positions shears around a target stem, closes blades at a precise location, retains the separated cutting, and transfers it to a bin.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two qualified safe impacts and a stable setting; record requires a cut 3–15 mm beyond the bud, preservation of the bud and plant, and controlled disposal without dropping the cutting.
comparison.reason: Precision cutting with preservation and fragment retention does not test dynamic adjustment. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift limits are undeclared.
